title: River & Blues-Downtown, Parking, Pool, River Front
description:
Comfort with touches of whimsy.  River views, parking outside your door, riverside pool (in-season), laundry room & fitness center.  Walk to downtown, only 2 blocks from Sounds Stadium and Brooklyn Bowl.  Your home away from home just far enough from the craziness of lower Broadway.

The space
This is a small space for 2 people.  There's a king size bed in the bedroom and the sofa, when made up as a bed, is also king size, so you can sleep separately.

Please note that although there is a bedroom, there is no door to close on the bedroom, just a small hallway leading to it, so it is not a completely private space.

There's a full kitchen with all appliances.  The remodeled bathroom has a shower, no bathtub.

**Please Note the pool opening is at the complete discretion of the condominium association and is weather permitting. It is usually open from the beginning of May to the end of October.
